classification_rules.CONTEXT_SCREEN_PASS_CALIBRATION_READY: all signal gates pass and immediate calibration capacity is reached
classification_rules.CONTEXT_SIGNAL_PRESENT_CAPACITY_LIMITED: all signal gates pass, the focal population census is exhausted, and capacity remains below the frozen requirement
classification_rules.CONTEXT_UNINFORMATIVE_POLLINATOR_LOW: pollinator effort completed but legitimate activity below frozen threshold
classification_rules.CONTEXT_UNINFORMATIVE_PREDATOR_LOW: predator effort completed but attack below frozen threshold
classification_rules.CONTEXT_UNINFORMATIVE_WATER_STATE: water-state effort completed but water functionality below frozen threshold
classification_rules.CONTEXT_UNINFORMATIVE_MULTIPLE_SIGNALS: registered signal effort completed but more than one signal is below its frozen screen threshold
classification_rules.CONTEXT_SCREEN_INCOMPLETE: one or more registered signal efforts are incomplete, or capacity is below requirement without an exhausted focal-population census
